title: Brand Awareness Video — streaming poster

location.series: Cox Brand Collection — Lindsay Little / Periscope

slide_intent: Connect a performance claim to an everyday task so the viewer has a reason to care about speed.
strategic_value: The kitchen activity can make Cox’s streaming message feel useful within family life.
demonstration: The supplied video poster overlays a blue-green sentence fragment on an adult and child looking at a tablet at a kitchen table. The still does not establish the complete claim or animation.
practical_value: Check whether the activity gives a technical benefit an understandable human context.

content_islands.name: Shared tablet task
content_islands.spec: Keep the adult, child and tablet together across the middle of the domestic scene.

content_islands.name: Headline fragment
content_islands.spec: Set the large colored line over the left-center of the photograph, retaining the source’s unfinished wording.
